title: Unlocking the Glory of God: Tapping into the Overflow
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he continues to unpack the profound message of Ezekiel 47, revealing the glory of God's presence that's overflowing into our lives and church. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris challenges us to tap into the increasing levels of God's blessing, from ankle-deep to knee-deep, and beyond, as we experience the dynamic power of God at work in our midst. Get ready to be stirred and inspired as Pastor Chris shares the revelation of a life-abundant, overflowing experience with God.
